paragraphs.en: LiteLLM is an open source AI Gateway that gives you a single, unified interface to call 100+ LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Azure, and more — using the OpenAI format.
paragraphs.zh: LiteLLM 是一个开源 AI 网关，它提供了一个统一接口，让你可以使用 OpenAI 格式调用 100 多家 LLM 提供商——OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Bedrock、Azure 等。

paragraphs.en: Use it as a Python SDK for direct library integration, or deploy the AI Gateway (Proxy Server) as a centralized service for your team or organization.
paragraphs.zh: 将其作为 Python SDK 直接集成到库中，或将 AI 网关（代理服务器）部署为面向您的团队或组织的集中式服务。

paragraphs.en: uv add litellm An independent litellm-core distribution provides the Python SDK with the same import litellm API and runtime dependencies. It has no optional extras, CLI entry points, or bundled dashboard. Install one SDK distribution per environment because litellm and litellm-core own overlapping Python files. Use litellm for the proxy, CLI, and optional extras

paragraphs.en: curl -X POST ' http://0.0.0.0:4000/v1/chat/completions ' \ -H ' Authorization: Bearer <your-master-key> ' \ -H ' Content-Type: application/json ' \ -d ' { "model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize the latest open PR"}], "tools": [{ "type": "mcp", "server_url": "litellm_proxy/mcp/github", "server_label": "github_mcp", "require_approval": "never" }] } ' Use with Cursor IDE { "mcpServers" : { "LiteLLM" : { "url" : " http://localhost:4000/mcp/ " , "headers" : { "x-litellm-api-key" : " Bearer <your-master-key> " } } } } For MCP OAuth, an upstream may advertise dynamic client registration but refuse requests with HTTP 401 or 403. If the provider requires a pre-registered OAuth app, configure its credentials.client_id and, when required, credentials.client_secret on the MCP server. This skips dynamic registration in the gateway sign-in flow. The provider must approve the app for MCP access; reaching its authorization page does not establish that login or tool calls will succeed
paragraphs.zh: curl -X POST ' http://0.0.0.0:4000/v1/chat/completions ' \ -H ' Authorization: Bearer <your-master-key> ' \ -H ' Content-Type: application/json ' \ -d ' { "model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "总结最新的开放 PR"}], "tools": [{ "type": "mcp", "server_url": "litellm_proxy/mcp/github", "server_label": "github_mcp", "require_approval": "never" }] } ' 在 Cursor IDE 中使用 { "mcpServers" : { "LiteLLM" : { "url" : " http://localhost:4000/mcp/ " , "headers" : { "x-litellm-api-key" : " Bearer <your-master-key> " } } } } 对于 MCP OAuth，上游可能声明支持动态客户端注册，但会以 HTTP 401 或 403 拒绝请求。 如果提供商要求预先注册的 OAuth 应用，请在 MCP 服务器上配置其 credentials.client_id，以及在需要时配置 credentials.client_secret。 这会跳过网关登录流程中的动态注册。 提供商必须批准该应用以进行 MCP 访问；能够访问其授权页面并不意味着登录或工具调用一定会成功。

paragraphs.en: Run the LiteLLM proxy as a production-ready componentized stack (gateway, backend, UI on separate services; managed Postgres + Redis + object store) using the published Terraform modules. Both modules are on the public Terraform Registry — no auth needed.
paragraphs.zh: 使用已发布的 Terraform 模块，将 LiteLLM 代理作为可用于生产的组件化技术栈运行（网关、后端、UI 分别部署在独立服务上；并使用托管的 Postgres + Redis + 对象存储）。 两个模块都发布在公共 Terraform Registry 上——无需身份验证。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm.git cd litellm/terraform/litellm/aws/examples/default cp terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars # edit region/tenant/env terraform init && terraform apply Module page →

paragraphs.en: Or call the module from your own root config:
paragraphs.zh: 或者从你自己的根配置中调用该模块：

paragraphs.en: # main.tf terraform { required_version = " >= 1.6.0 " required_providers { aws = { source = " hashicorp/aws " , version = " ~> 5.60 " } } } provider "aws" { region = " us-west-2 " } module "litellm" { source = " BerriAI/litellm/aws " version = " ~> 1.89 " region = " us-west-2 " azs = [ " us-west-2a " , " us-west-2b " ] tenant = " acme " env = " prod " # Production: provide an ACM cert. Without one, set allow_plaintext_alb = true # (dev/trial only). # acm_certificate_arn = "arn:aws:acm:us-west-2:111122223333:certificate/..." allow_plaintext_alb = true } output "litellm_url" { value = module . litellm . alb_dns_name } terraform init terraform apply Provider API keys live in AWS Secrets Manager; reference ARNs via gateway_extra_secrets . Full input list and architecture diagram on the registry page .

Opens Cloud Shell, clones the terraform-google-litellm module mirror at the latest stable release (a small download instead of the full litellm repo), and walks you through terraform apply via a built-in DeployStack tutorial . Pick the project, the tutorial sets up the Artifact Registry remote repo, writes terraform.tfvars from your answers, and runs apply
paragraphs.zh: 真正的一键部署。 它会打开 Cloud Shell，克隆 terraform-google-litellm 模块镜像的最新稳定版本（只需下载很小的内容，而不是完整的 litellm 仓库），并通过内置的 DeployStack 教程引导你完成 terraform apply。 选择项目后，该教程会设置 Artifact Registry 远程仓库，根据你的回答写入 terraform.tfvars，并运行 apply。

paragraphs.en: To call the module from your own config instead, Cloud Run can't pull from ghcr.io directly, so first set up a one-time Artifact Registry remote repo backed by GHCR:
paragraphs.zh: 若要改为从您自己的配置中调用该模块，由于 Cloud Run 无法直接从 ghcr.io 拉取，因此首先需要设置一个由 GHCR 支持的一次性 Artifact Registry 远程仓库：

paragraphs.en: gcloud artifacts repositories create litellm \ --location=us-central1 \ --repository-format=docker \ --mode=remote-repository \ --remote-docker-repo=https://ghcr.io \ --project=my-gcp-project Then:
paragraphs.zh:
gcloud artifacts repositories create litellm \
  --location=us-central1 \
  --repository-format=docker \
  --mode=remote-repository \
  --remote-docker-repo=https://ghcr.io \
  --project=my-gcp-project

然后：

paragraphs.en: # main.tf terraform { required_version = " >= 1.6.0 " required_providers { google = { source = " hashicorp/google " , version = " ~> 6.10 " } google-beta = { source = " hashicorp/google-beta " , version = " ~> 6.10 " } } } provider "google" { project = " my-gcp-project " ; region = " us-central1 " } provider "google-beta" { project = " my-gcp-project " ; region = " us-central1 " } module "litellm" { source = " BerriAI/litellm/google " version = " ~> 1.89 " project_id = " my-gcp-project " region = " us-central1 " tenant = " acme " env = " prod " # Replace my-gcp-project with your GCP project ID (same value as project_id above). image_registry = " us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/my-gcp-project/litellm/berriai " # Production: provide DNS already pointing at the LB IP for Google-managed certs. # Without one, set allow_plaintext_lb = true (dev/trial only). # lb_domains = ["proxy.example.com"] allow_plaintext_lb = true } output "litellm_url" { value = module . litellm . load_balancer_url } terraform init terraform apply Provider API keys live in Secret Manager; reference resource IDs (e.g. projects/my-gcp-project/secrets/openai-api-key ) via gateway_extra_secrets . Full input list and architecture diagram on the registry page .
paragraphs.zh: # main.tf terraform { required_version = " >= 1.6.0 " required_providers { google = { source = " hashicorp/google " , version = " ~> 6.10 " } google-beta = { source = " hashicorp/google-beta " , version = " ~> 6.10 " } } } provider "google" { project = " my-gcp-project " ; region = " us-central1 " } provider "google-beta" { project = " my-gcp-project " ; region = " us-central1 " } module "litellm" { source = " BerriAI/litellm/google " version = " ~> 1.89 " project_id = " my-gcp-project " region = " us-central1 " tenant = " acme " env = " prod " # 将 my-gcp-project 替换为你的 GCP 项目 ID（与上方 project_id 的值相同）。 image_registry = " us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/my-gcp-project/litellm/berriai " # 生产环境：提供已指向负载均衡器 IP 的 DNS，以便使用 Google 托管证书。 # 如果没有，请设置 allow_plaintext_lb = true（仅限开发/试用）。 # lb_domains = ["proxy.example.com"] allow_plaintext_lb = true } output "litellm_url" { value = module . litellm . load_balancer_url } terraform init terraform apply 提供商的 API 密钥保存在 Secret Manager 中；通过 gateway_extra_secrets 引用资源 ID（例如 projects/my-gcp-project/secrets/openai-api-key ）。 完整的输入列表和架构图请见注册表页面。

paragraphs.en: All LiteLLM Docker images published to GHCR are signed with cosign . Releases are signed with the key introduced in commit e82a3c6 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有发布到 GHCR 的 LiteLLM Docker 镜像均使用 cosign 签名。 发布版本使用 commit e82a3c6 中引入的密钥进行签名。

sents.en: All LiteLLM Docker images published to GHCR are signed with cosign .
sents.zh: 所有发布到 GHCR 的 LiteLLM Docker 镜像均使用 cosign 签名。

sents.en: Releases are signed with the key introduced in commit e82a3c6 .
sents.zh: 发布版本使用 commit e82a3c6 中引入的密钥进行签名。

paragraphs.en: Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):
paragraphs.zh: 使用固定的提交哈希（pinned commit hash）进行验证（推荐）：

paragraphs.en: A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key:
paragraphs.zh: 提交哈希具有密码学上的不可变性，因此这是确保你使用的是已发布签名密钥的最可靠方式：

paragraphs.en: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm: < release-tag > Verify using a release tag (convenience):
paragraphs.zh: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm: < release-tag > 使用发行标签（release tag）进行验证（便捷方式）：

paragraphs.en: Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:
paragraphs.zh: 在此仓库中，标签受到保护，并且解析为同一个密钥。 此选项更易读，但依赖于标签保护规则：

sents.en: Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key.
sents.zh: 在此仓库中，标签受到保护，并且解析为同一个密钥。

sents.en: This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:
sents.zh: 此选项更易读，但依赖于标签保护规则：

paragraphs.en: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/ < release-tag > /cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm: < release-tag > Replace <release-tag> with the version you are deploying (e.g. v1.83.0-stable ).
paragraphs.zh: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/ < release-tag > /cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm: < release-tag > 请将 <release-tag> 替换为你正在部署的版本（例如 v1.83.0-stable ）。

paragraphs.zh: 📖 想参与文档贡献吗？ LiteLLM 文档已迁移至一个单独的仓库：BerriAI/litellm-docs。 请在该仓库中提交文档相关的 PR。 文档发布于 docs.litellm.ai。

sents.en: 📖 Contributing to documentation?
sents.zh: 📖 想参与文档贡献吗？

sents.en: The LiteLLM docs have moved to a separate repository: BerriAI/litellm-docs .
sents.zh: LiteLLM 文档已迁移至一个单独的仓库：BerriAI/litellm-docs。

sents.en: Please open doc PRs there.
sents.zh: 请在该仓库中提交文档相关的 PR。

sents.en: Docs are served at docs.litellm.ai .
sents.zh: 文档发布于 docs.litellm.ai。

paragraphs.en: LiteLLM follows the Google Python Style Guide .
paragraphs.zh: LiteLLM 遵循 Google Python 风格指南。

paragraphs.en: All these checks must pass before your PR can be merged.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些检查都必须通过，你的 PR 才能被合并。
